explanation: This component fires only at D2, and only when the agent chose a1 but landed in S2 by a rare transition: then it is about 9-10, highest (10) when the trial before was an a2 choice that rarely reached S1, and about 8 on a repeat of the same a1-to-S2 rare event. Every other step is 0: all D1 and GO steps, every a2 choice (including a2 rarely reaching S1), and common a1-to-S1 trials, which reach at most 1 right after an a1-to-S2 rare trial.
